purpose: Three focused desktop section mockups, not a complete homepage

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity horizontal 16:9 desktop website HERO section mockup, not a full page, for AXON ENJIN, a software company whose product Operating Layer brings branches, people, stock and reports into one system. This is a proposed VISUAL OVERHAUL: white canvas, charcoal ink #14171c, restrained Axon cobalt #2e6fff, very pale blue #edf3ff, cool gray rules. Inspired by the clarity and personality of getcko.vercel.app: short human copy, visible specific workflow, generous white space. Do not copy its mascot or green palette.
Art direction: a confident software brand designed by a small excellent studio. Swiss grid, broad friendly grotesk similar to Satoshi or Neue Montreal, sentence case, medium weight, precise negative tracking, no condensed or uppercase headlines. Typography drives composition. Clean white is dominant, no gradients, no glows, no glass, no 3D, no abstract blobs. Header with original text wordmark 'AXON ENJIN' at left, small blue dot before it; understated 'Product', 'Modules', 'Company' nav toward right; compact cobalt 8px-radius 'Talk to us' button far right. Header lower hairline, generous 64px horizontal margins.
Hero composition: editorial top-left lead, support in top-right, full-width product demonstration beneath. Upper left small blue label 'Operating Layer'. Large 82px headline across only two lines exactly 'One system.' and 'Every branch.' in charcoal. Right of headline with breathing room, 21px support 'Bring your people, stock, and reports into one place. Add the tools you need.' Below support one cobalt button 'See modules' and quiet text link 'Talk to us ↗'. Do not put headline and product UI in the stock left-text right-image arrangement. Headline occupies upper 40 percent of section, wide product interface lower 48 percent with ample vertical gap.
Product demonstration: flat straight-on wide white application window with 10px corners, fine cool gray border and extremely soft shadow. App toolbar 'Operating Layer' on left, tabs 'Inventory', 'People', 'Reports' with Inventory blue underline, 'All branches' control right. No nested cards, no gratuitous metrics. Main header 'Stock by branch'. A very legible sparse table with columns 'Item', 'Branch A', 'Branch B', 'Branch C' and rows 'Coffee beans' 120 85 64; 'Cups' 430 220 310; 'Milk' 180 120 95. Make one table row gently pale blue, and one small cobalt dot at the selected row edge as the only recognizable signal motif. All sample numbers are unit quantities without prices/currency. Frame footer left 'Three branches. One view.' right 'Illustrative product view'. Small tasteful UI typography, readable rather than a fake complicated dashboard. Very clean alignment. Natural vertical layout fits one laptop viewport, whitespace deliberate, polished design review artifact without phone or laptop hardware, no browser chrome. No fake customer logos, fake claims or testimonials. Produce a visually compelling, buildable real web design, not a wireframe.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE horizontal 16:9 high fidelity desktop website MODULE EXPLORER SECTION mockup for AXON ENJIN. Use the attached hero only as a visual-system reference, not an edit target: keep the same white/charcoal/Axon cobalt #2e6fff/pale-blue #edf3ff system, broad tightly tracked Satoshi-like grotesk, quiet gray hairlines, 8px button radius, 10px app window radius. Same company and same product Operating Layer. This is section 2 of a focused three-section design exploration, not a full website. No nav header in this section. No glow, gradient, 3D objects, stock illustration, gratuitous metrics, cards inside cards, fake customer proof, price or currency.
Art direction: polished Swiss grid with enough asymmetry and negative space to feel designed. White background. 64px outer margins, comfortable 90px top space. At top a very small cobalt label 'Built around your branches'. Below, 60px medium-weight charcoal two-line heading 'Start with Core.' / 'Add what you need.' At upper right short 19px text 'Each module adds a tab to the same system.' 
Main section below: one flat left selector about 30% width, one app view about 62% width on right, generous gap. Left selector is a vertical list with fine separators and a restrained active cobalt indicator, seven rows with readable generous 18px text: 'Core' with small quiet tag 'Required', 'HR', 'Inventory', 'CRM', 'Reporting', 'Accounting', 'Scheduling'. Inventory row is selected with light blue wash and a small cobalt dot. No boxed individual tiles. At bottom of left list a tiny line 'Choose a tool. See how it works.'
Right app window: front-facing, fine cool gray border, extremely subtle shadow, white background. Top chrome 'Operating Layer', 'Inventory' active with cobalt underline, 'All branches' dropdown. In its content, heading 'Stock moves'. Subcopy 'Move stock between branches. Keep one shared record.' Then a simple readable transfer review form arranged in a clean 2-column grid, labeled fields 'From' with 'Branch A', 'To' with 'Branch B'; next row 'Item' with 'Coffee beans', 'Quantity' with '20'. Beneath a thin horizontal divider and a muted sentence 'Review the move before confirming.' Compact cobalt button 'Review transfer' at bottom right. Footer outside app window small gray caption 'Illustrative product view · Sample data'.
Below content at lower right, a small underlined cobalt website text link 'Ask about Inventory ↗'. This is a proposed product workflow, not proof of shipped capability. Keep table/form type comfortably readable and realistic, not microscopically tiny. Whitespace is purposeful; use 3 typography scales and clean alignment. Show this ONE section only, no hero, no contact, no presentation labels.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity horizontal 16:9 website CONTACT SECTION mockup for AXON ENJIN, matching the attached hero reference's broad clean Satoshi-like grotesk typography, charcoal, white, cobalt #2e6fff and pale blue, clean 8px rounded buttons/inputs. The reference is visual-system guidance, not an edit target. This is one focused section in a three-section design exploration. Do not show a full website, hero, module section or multiple frames. This should have a different visual rhythm from the white hero and white module explorer.
Composition: a bold full-width pure cobalt blue contact surface covering upper 84% of the image, with a white footer strip beneath. No outer boxed card, no pill perimeter, no inset card around form. All content grid aligned with 76px outer margins. On the left 46%, small white label 'Talk to the builders'. Below a large 72px medium-bold sentence-case white headline broken in exactly three short intentional lines: 'What’s getting' / 'harder to' / 'manage?' Beneath in 20px white at comfortable contrast: 'Tell us about your branches and the tools you use.' Then in slightly smaller white type 'We work like your in-house developers.' Keep breathing room below, with three compact plain text offer lines separated by subtle translucent white hairlines: 'Operating Layer' / 'Modules + customization' / 'Custom AI software'. Do not invent clients, testimonials, prices or proof.
Right 43%, aligned a little below top label, an airy simple contact form, directly on blue background, no white form card. Keep visible labels white and inputs pure white with charcoal text. Two-column row labels 'Name' and 'Work email', placeholders 'Your name' and 'you@company.com'. Next row 'Company' and 'Branches (optional)', placeholders 'Your company' and 'e.g. 3'. Full width label 'What do you need help with?' above a white textarea roughly 120px tall, placeholder 'Tell us about your current setup.' Generous 20px vertical spacing. Bottom right a white-filled compact rectangular 8px-radius primary button with charcoal text 'Talk to us ↗'. Do not include fake success notifications or invented contact details.
At bottom a white footer strip, roomy and clean. Left original text wordmark 'AXON ENJIN' with small cobalt dot. Middle gray small 'Metro Manila, Philippines'. Right simple charcoal text links 'Modules', 'Company', 'Ventures', 'Contact'. Ventures is only in footer, not a primary CTA. A thin cool gray hairline above footer lower caption '© 2026 Axon Enjin'. Designed site screenshot without device/browser chrome. Contrast should be excellent, all labels readable, understated finesse, no gradient, glow, mascot, stock portrait, futuristic decoration or visual clutter. Main headline remains dominant but does not crowd the form.
